title: Verify Refund-Service Split — Zero Gaps
description: Comprehensive verification that refund-service is fully functional, payment-service is clean, and all cross-service integration points are wired correctly.

stories.title: Payment-service compilation — zero dead references
acceptanceCriteria: No imports of deleted classes (RefundService, AdminRefundController, Refund, RefundItem, RefundRepository, RefundItemRepository) in payment-service source
PaymentService.java does not inject RefundRepository
PaymentDevDataLoader.java does not reference Refund or RefundItem
KafkaTopicConfig.java has zero refund-related topic beans
All remaining Java files compile cleanly (no broken imports or missing symbols)

stories.title: Refund-service compilation — all files present
acceptanceCriteria: All required Java files exist: Application, Config (5), Domain (4), Repo (4), DTO (5), Service (1), Controller (1)
All package imports use com.flashsale.refundservice.* (no leakage from payment-service)
pom.xml has NO Axon dependency
application.yaml has correct schema (refund), port 8094, Eureka enabled, Stripe config present, NO Axon config
Dockerfile.dev and Dockerfile.prod exist with correct port 8094
Flyway migration V1__init_refund_schema.sql exists

stories.title: API Gateway routes refund requests to refund-service
acceptanceCriteria: RouteConfig.java has a 'refund' route pointing to lb://refund-service
Path pattern /api/v1/admin/refunds/** is routed to refund-service (not payment-service)
No path conflict between payment and refund routes

stories.title: Payment-Refund cross-service communication complete
acceptanceCriteria: REFUND_STRIPE_AUTO Kafka consumer exists in RefundService (payment→refund)
TransactionRepository exists in refund-service for cross-schema reads
SellerTransferRepository exists in refund-service for cross-schema writes
KafkaTopicConfig in refund-service has all 12 required topics

stories.title: Docker Compose — refund-service in all compose files
acceptanceCriteria: docker-compose.yml has refund-service block with port 8094
docker-compose-backend.yml has refund-service block
docker-compose.prod-pulled.yml has refund-service image reference
.env.example has PORT_REFUND=8094 and JVM_OPTS_REFUND

stories.title: CI/CD — refund-service in all workflows
acceptanceCriteria: ci-build.yml: refund-service in structure validation, JAR upload, build matrix, case statements
deploy.yml: refund-service in JAR upload, build matrix, case statement, env template, export list

stories.title: Documents updated — all references corrected
acceptanceCriteria: README.md includes refund-service in folder structure
INDEX.md microservice count updated to 12, 8 traditional
refund-service docs created: br-refund.md, KAFKA_EVENTS.md, entity-refund.md
payment-service docs have MOVED notices for refund entities
